props.description: The regions, a GeoJSON FeatureCollection of polygons in longitude and latitude.
props.name: features

props.description: Each region's value, by its `idKey` property; a region with none is drawn empty.
props.name: values

props.description: The property that identifies a region in `values`; `id` by default.
props.name: idKey

props.description: The property that names a region; `name` by default.
props.name: nameKey

props.description: The map's accessible name and the data table's caption, such as "Orders by region, October".
props.name: label

props.description: How values are written; plain numbers in the locale by default.
props.name: valueFormat

props.description: The colour the five shades are made from; the first accent step by default.
props.name: color

props.description: The map's height in pixels; 280 by default.
props.name: height
